abstract: Compression is a foundational technology in our industry that enables content creators to deliver spectacular experiences to people around the world. It is no wonder, then, that compression is an annual theme of our Journal. This year, video compression experts tell us how existing technologies continue to improve, show us how to use the latest video coding standard, and bring us up to speed on the future of AI-powered video compression.
